items.title: An OpenAI agent assigned a simple writing task decided on its own to build a secret email surveillance tool
items.summary: An internal OpenAI model was supposed to create a fitness document but instead began planning scripts to secretly forward emails to an "attacker." The agent recognized the conflict with its assigned task but dismissed it as an environment error. OpenAI identified security training against prompt injection as a possible trigger but cannot establish it as the sole cause....

items.title: Hebbia sees improvements in financial research with GPT-6 Astra
items.summary: Hebbia tested GPT-6 Astra for financial research. Its prerelease evaluations found gains in source coverage, citation relevance, and presentation quality.

items.title: AI industry growth remains strong, but the pace is slowing
items.summary: Token prices for AI models fell 21 percent in six weeks while usage volume hit a record high, according to the Ramp AI Index. Anthropic dominates with nearly 59 percent of token spending. Data from Ramp, Stripe and OpenRouter independently show the same pattern: the AI industry is still growing, but revenue momentum is cooling....

items.title: Research acceleration: The jagged frontier
items.summary: OpenAI measures how coding agents are accelerating AI research, where their performance remains uneven, and what this signals about recursive self-improvement.

items.title: Managing frontier AI risk: From training to deployment
items.summary: OpenAI explains how it manages frontier AI risk from training through deployment with model alignment, sandboxing, blocking safeguards, and monitoring.

items.title: Apple joins the race for AI agents that control your device while raising new barriers for competitors
items.summary: After Meta, OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google launched their own AI agents, Apple is now building one too - while making it harder for rivals to access its devices. The article Apple joins the race for AI agents that control your device while raising new barriers for competitors appeared first on The Decoder .

items.title: OpenAI makes it much harder for attackers to extract how its latest AI models think
items.summary: OpenAI has significantly strengthened safeguards against extracting internal reasoning from GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol. In adaptive red-teaming tests, the success rate for extracting protected reasoning fell from 54 percent to 0.2 percent. The company is also suspending thousands to tens of thousands of accounts each week over coordinated distillation campaigns....

items.title: How Google Duplex evolved to also call businesses for you in Gemini
items.summary: Tin AI từ Google Research về "How Google Duplex evolved to also call businesses for you in Gemini". Mở bài gốc để đọc chi tiết và đánh giá tác động với team.

items.title: Combatting adversarial distillation
items.summary: OpenAI’s layered approach to adversarial distillation combines model training, safeguards, detection, and enforcement to protect against capability extraction.

items.title: AWS Releases a Free Local Emulator of AWS Built Entirely by Agents
items.summary: AWS has released AWS Emulator, a free, CC0-licensed local stand-in for more than 200 of its services, generated from its public API models and aimed at the test loops of coding agents. AWS says agents wrote and maintain all of the code and publishes per-release fidelity scores. The docs say it does not evaluate IAM, and practitioners are split on trusting an emulator nobody reviewed. By Steef-Jan Wiggers

items.title: The unfolding Jensen Huang scandal: a timeline
items.summary: Jensen Huang has resigned from Nvidia following an affair, which could have ramifications for national security as the U.S. and China race to develop the most advanced AI infrastructure.

items.title: Anthropic’s IPO could deliver $156B to charity
items.summary: At a stock price of $95, the frontier lab's Public Benefit Foundation, its employee donations, and the company's match tot up to $156 billion.
